description_en: Invoke the AiccsSmartCall API to initiate an Intelligent Speech Interaction call
description_zh: 调用AiccsSmartCall接口发起智能语音交互通话
name: AiccsSmartCall

parameters.help_en: Product name. Default value: aiccs
parameters.help_zh: 产品名称。默认取值：aiccs
parameters.name: prod_code

parameters.help_en:
The caller ID displayed to the callee. This must be a number you have purchased.

You can log on to the Contact Center console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7f9bf9658X6jte) to view your purchased numbers
parameters.help_zh:
被叫显号，必须是已购买的号码。

您可以登录联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7f9bf9658X6jte)，查看已购买的号码
parameters.name: called_show_number

parameters.help_en: Called number. Only numbers in the Chinese mainland are supported.
parameters.help_zh: 被叫号码。仅支持中国内地号码
parameters.name: called_number

parameters.help_en:
The Intelligent Outbound Call playback audio file supports both network files and TTS. Multiple files and TTS parameters can be mixed for playback, separated by commas (,). The replacement values for TTS parameters are specified in VoiceCodeParam.

When the playback file is a network file: Set the VoiceCode parameter to a publicly accessible URL of the audio file. We recommend using a WAV-formatted audio file with a sampling frequency of 8000 Hz or 16000 Hz.
When the playback file uses TTS: Set the VoiceCode parameter to a variable name such as $name$, and define the corresponding content for this variable in VoiceCodeParam
parameters.help_zh:
智能外呼放音文件，支持网络文件和TTS方式。其中，支持使用多个文件和TTS参数混播，之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。TTS参数的替换值在VoiceCodeParam中指定。

放音文件为网络文件时：参数VoiceCode指定为可被公网访问的语音文件URL，建议您使用采样频率为8000Hz或16000Hz且为wav格式的语音文件。
放音文件为TTS时：参数VoiceCode指定为变量名称如$name$，需要在VoiceCodeParam中设置变量对应的内容
parameters.name: voice_code

parameters.help_en:
An ID reserved for the caller. This ID will be returned to the caller in the receipt message.  
It is a string with a length of 1 to 15 bytes
parameters.help_zh:
预留给调用方使用的ID，最终会通过在回执消息中将此ID带回给调用方。
字符串类型，长度为1~15个字节
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en: The parameter is not supported yet
parameters.help_zh: 参数暂不支持使用
parameters.name: play_times

parameters.help_en: The volume for playing user audio. Valid values range from -4 to 4. We recommend setting it to 1
parameters.help_zh: 播放用户音频的音量，取值范围为-4~4，建议设置为1
parameters.name: volume

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not currently supported
parameters.help_zh: 参数暂不支持使用
parameters.name: speed

parameters.help_en: ASR model ID. You can view the ASR model ID on the ASR Model Management page (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/sentence/model/private?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7f9b2964fYSGv4)
parameters.help_zh: ASR模型ID。请在ASR模型管理页面 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/sentence/model/private?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7f9b2964fYSGv4)查看ASR模型ID
parameters.name: asr_model_id

parameters.help_en:
ASR foundation model.

customer_service_8k: Mandarin.
dialect_customer_service_8k: Heavy accent.

When invoking the SendCcoSmartCall API, you must specify an ASR model. We recommend that you provide either the asrModelId or AsrBaseId parameter.
If only asrModelId is set, the specified ASR model is used.
If only AsrBaseId is set, the specified ASR foundation model is used.
If neither parameter is set, the default ASR foundation model is used. By default, AsrBaseId is customer_service_8k, which corresponds to the Mandarin ASR foundation model.
If both parameters are set, confirm that they correctly correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh:
SR基础模型。

customer_service_8k：普通话。
dialect_customer_service_8k：重口音。

调用接口SendCcoSmartCall时，需要指定使用的ASR模型，建议参数asrModelId和AsrBaseId二者选填一个。
如果仅设置asrModelId，表示使用指定的ASR模型。
如果仅设置AsrBaseId，表示使用指定的ASR基础模型。
如果二者均未设置，则使用默认的ASR基础模型，即参数AsrBaseId默认为customer_service_8k，表示使用ASR普通话基础模型。
如果二者同时设置，请确认二者是正确对应的
parameters.name: asr_base_id

parameters.help_en: Acoustic model ID
parameters.help_zh: 声学模型ID
parameters.name: asr_als_am_id

parameters.help_en: Hotword ID. You can view the ASR hotword ID on the ASR Hotword Management Page (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/sentence/vocab?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7f9bf965IKBpsi).
parameters.help_zh: 热词ID。请在ASR热词管理页面 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/sentence/vocab?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7f9bf965IKBpsi)查看ASR热词ID
parameters.name: asr_vocabulary_id

parameters.help_en: Whether to record during the call
parameters.help_zh: 通话过程中是否录音
parameters.name: record_flag

parameters.help_en:
Pause duration. Specifies how long the user must pause to indicate the end of a sentence. Unit: milliseconds. Valid range: 300–1200.

If the specified value is outside this range, PauseTime defaults to 800.
Only the first setting takes effect; subsequent settings are ignored
parameters.help_zh:
停顿时长。用于设置用户停顿多久，表示一句话结束。单位为毫秒，取值范围为300~1200。

如果指定值不在参数范围中，则默认PauseTime为800。
首次设置有效，后续设置无效
parameters.name: pause_time

parameters.help_en:
Silence duration. This parameter defines how long the call waits for user speech before ending the call. The unit is milliseconds, and valid values range from 1000 to 20000.

If the specified value is outside this range, MuteTime defaults to 10000.
This parameter can be dynamically updated during the call. The last set value takes effect
parameters.help_zh:
静音时长。用于设置用户多久不说话通话结束。单位为毫秒，取值范围为1000~20000。

如果指定值不在参数范围中，则默认MuteTime为10000。
通话过程中可动态设置，以最后一次设置为准
parameters.name: mute_time

parameters.help_en: Whether the initial audio playback file is interruptible. The default value is true, which means the initial audio playback file can be interrupted.
parameters.help_zh: 开场放音文件是否可打断。默认为true，即开场放音文件可打断
parameters.name: action_code_break

parameters.help_en: A dynamic extension ID reserved for the caller, which is returned in the webhook address to serve as the customer's developer identity
parameters.help_zh: 预留给调用方使用的动态扩展ID，在回调地址中带回，用于客户的开发标识
parameters.name: dynamic_id

parameters.help_en:
Early media speech recognition identity. When set to true, it records the reason why the call was not answered. Default value: false, meaning disabled.

To enable early media speech recognition, you must manually set this parameter to true
parameters.help_zh:
早媒体语音识别标识。设为true会记录通话未接听的原因。默认为fasle，即关闭状态。

如果需要启用早媒体语音识别标识，请手动设为true
parameters.name: early_media_asr

parameters.help_en: TTS parameter string in JSON format. It must correspond to the TTS parameters of VoiceCode
parameters.help_zh: TTS参数传递字符串，格式为JSON。必须与VoiceCode的TTS参数对应
parameters.name: voice_code_param

parameters.help_en: Maximum call duration, in seconds. The call is automatically disconnected after timeout
parameters.help_zh: 最大通话时长，单位为秒，超时后自动挂断
parameters.name: session_timeout

parameters.help_en: Interrupts based on the user's continuous speaking duration. Takes effect only when ActionCodeBreak is true. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 基于用户持续说话时长打断，在ActionCodeBreak为true时生效。单位为毫秒
parameters.name: action_code_time_break

parameters.help_en:
Whether to configure TTS voice parameters.
If set to true, you must use the TtsStyle, TtsVolume, and TtsSpeed parameters to define the voice style.
If set to false, related parameters are not required and will have no effect even if configured
parameters.help_zh:
是否设置TTS声音参数。
指定为true：需要通过TtsStyle、TtsColume、TtsSpeed三个参数来设置声音风格。
定为false：不需要设置相关参数，即便设置了也不生效
parameters.name: tts_conf

parameters.help_en: Voice style used during TTS variable playback. Default value: xiaoyun. For available styles, see the voice style list
parameters.help_zh: TTS变量播放时的声音风格，默认为xiaoyun，具体风格请参见声音风格列表
parameters.name: tts_style

parameters.help_en: The volume for TTS variable playback. Valid values range from 0 to 100. The default value is 0
parameters.help_zh: TTS变量播放的音量，取值范围为0~100，默认为0
parameters.name: tts_volume

parameters.help_en: Speech speed when playing TTS variables. Valid values range from -200 to 200. The default value is 0.
parameters.help_zh: TTS变量播放时的声音速度，取值范围为-200~200，默认为0
parameters.name: tts_speed

parameters.help_en:
Whether to execute ITN during post-processing.  

When set to true, Chinese numerals are converted to Arabic numerals in the output. The default value is false.
parameters.help_zh:
是否在后处理中执行ITN。

设置为true时，中文数字将转为阿拉伯数字输出，默认为false
parameters.name: enable_itn

parameters.help_en:
ID of the background audio file played during the conversation between the user and the robot.  

You can log on to the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview), choose Intelligent Interaction > Audio File Management, and click View to check the corresponding audio ID.
parameters.help_zh:
用户和机器人对话时播放的背景语音文件ID。

您可以登录智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)，选择智能交互 > 语音文件管理，单击详情，查看对应的语音ID
parameters.name: background_file_code

parameters.help_en: The parameter is not supported yet
parameters.help_zh: 参数暂不支持使用
parameters.name: background_volume

parameters.help_en: This parameter is currently not supported
parameters.help_zh: 参数暂不支持使用
parameters.name: background_speed

Code.description_en: Unique receipt ID for this call.

Data.description_en: Request status code. A return value of "OK" indicates that the request succeeded.
Data.description_zh: 请求状态码。返回OK代表请求成功
